title: Chapter 1396
text:
On the other side, many direct Beyond Grade As left the venue together, still thinking about Dylan's death.

"Black Star is really domineering. He killed a peak Beyond Grade A right in front of us."

Reeve clicked her tongue and curled her lips.

"He wants to set an example. Dylan was unlucky to be chosen as the target, but he deserved it."

Clottey looked straight ahead and said with a calm tone.

"I saw those revivors running away trembling in fear. Isn't Black Star afraid of scaring them away?"

"If they run again, they'll follow in Dylan's footsteps. Plus, are they willing to leave?"

Clottey shook his head.

At this moment, Oulou stroked his chin with a worried expression and said in a low voice,

"Black Star controls this channel and used benefits to tie up almost all the Beyond Grade As. The association's power is already too big to be shaken. I'm afraid the problem of the Super imbalance can no longer be solved …"

Hearing this, the hearts of the direct descendants trembled. They were worried about the future of the three Universal Civilizations.

It was now a time of war, so Black Star provided revival services to the advanced civilizations. However, in the long run, if they got rid of the pressure of the foreign enemy, they did not know if Black Star would still be willing to sell the revival slots. At that time, the direct descendants might lose the benefits of the Sanctum Revival. The difference between the individual strength of the two sides would become greater and greater.

The association had an independent political status, possessed astonishing strength, and had the merits and reputation of participating in the war. It would be difficult for the three Universal Civilizations to do anything else. They had dug a hole for themselves, and they had to jump into it even if they had tears in their eyes. No one knew how the upper echelons could suppress such a huge monster.

"I'm afraid the only way to break out of this situation is to develop the Sanctum Revival ourselves. It's a pity that I don't know how long it will take."

Oulou sighed.

Now that the Sanctum Revival had an even more fatal attraction, some of the direct descendants in the crowd were also tempted. After all, the treatment of the two was worlds apart.

While everyone was worried, Hilbert did not say anything. His eyes kept flashing.

As a 'retiree' who had completed his service and thought that he had fulfilled his duty to the three Universal Civilizations, he was very interested in the treatment of the association. Compared to the Sanctum Revival, the 'retirement treatment' that he had sacrificed his life for was not worth mentioning.

Although he had the patience to wait for the three Universal Civilizations to study the Sanctum Revival, with his understanding of the three Universal Civilizations, he knew that this would not be a free lunch. The way he saw it, the three Universal Civilizations would probably set some conditions as restrictions, such as continuing to serve the civilization.

However, this was a situation where there were no competitors. Now, with the association's lenient Sanctum Revival as a comparison, Hilbert felt that even if the three Universal Civilizations really created the Sanctum Revival, they would most likely have to 'lower' their prices and not set conditions that were too harsh. The existence of the association forced the three Universal Civilizations to improve their treatment.

Thinking of this, Hilbert glanced at the crowd with a disapproving look.

It was really funny that this group of people were still here "worrying about the country and the people", but they didn't know that the existence of the association was also their good news.

Fighting for the benefit of the entire Beyond Grade A class … He really has been carrying out the mission of the association.

Hilbert's eyes flickered with admiration.

Since he had already "retired", joining the association wasn't a bad choice …

…

Two days later, in the Army Commander's office.

Han Xiao sat on a wide chair, swiping the virtual screen casually to check the reactions of the various Beyond Grade As over the past two days. He was quite satisfied.

After he revealed the truth of the Sanctum Revival, the morale of the Beyond Grade As was high. Originally, they were more or less relaxed, but now, they were even tighter. Their fighting spirit was unprecedentedly high, and even their training was harder.

"Although only a reasonable request to be united against the outside world can stimulate such cohesion, it's enough."

Han Xiao knocked on the armrest of the chair and pondered.

He did not pursue the so-called absolute control, as long as he achieved his goal. Therefore, he did not have the intention of 'taming' a portion of the Beyond Grade As. His attitude so far was enough. With the temptation of benefits, and with Dylan as an example, there was no need to continue using methods.

Han Xiao suddenly thought of something and chuckled.

"This should be the most united Beyond Grade As in history. It would be great if they could stay united forever."

As he said that, he shook his head and laughed. After all, it was an unrealistic fantasy. Internal divisions and different ideals, only interests were eternal. It was destined that only interests could bind everyone.

… Oh, it could not be said that everyone was attracted. Almost all the living Beyond Grade As had been attracted, but there were still exceptions. Pangon's group of avengers had not contacted the Holy Covenant and had not expressed any intention of returning to participate in the battle.

The civilization of this group of people was destroyed, and their hatred was much deeper than Dylan's. They had long decided to sacrifice their lives for the cause of revenge. Although the Sanctum Revival was tempting, it did not make them give up on revenge.

The main reason was that they knew their limits. They knew that as long as they did not give up on revenge, Black Star would not revive them and continue to cause trouble. Pangon did not want to come back and implicate the association, so he simply ignored them.

The frontlines did not lack these few combatants, and Han Xiao did not want to revive these troublesome fellows, so he let them be. He did not specifically call them back, not wanting to give them a way out.

"Tsk, you're quite 'determined'. I hope you guys can keep it up."

Han Xiao curled his lips.

This group of avengers had a firm goal and was not 'tempted' by the Sanctum Revival. However, with Han Xiao's status, he no longer had any admiration for this. Everyone had their own ambitions. In his eyes, there was no difference between Pangon and Dylan's choice.

He was satisfied that this group of people was tactful and did not cause him any trouble.

Sitting in this position, he had too many things to take care of. External wars, class interests, and dealing with the three Universal Civilizations, he did not have the time to spoil others. Everything was guided by the goal. Whoever caused trouble for him, he would not hesitate to deal with them. All difficulties and reasons were empty. If he wanted to understand the difficulties of others, others would not understand him first.

Therefore, for the past two days, Dylan had been cursing in the Underworld, and Han Xiao could not be bothered to talk to him.

Previously, Han Xiao had deliberately promised in front of everyone that he would let him go in the future. Only after getting everyone's supervision did he execute him, which made this guy have thoughts. Therefore, no matter how much Dylan jumped around, as long as he had this core, this guy would still obediently work. There was no need to waste his breath.

"However, this guy did provide me with an interesting ability …"

Han Xiao calmed himself down and opened the interface to look at the skill list. His expression was a little strange.

Two days ago, he had already settled the mission rewards. He did not know if it was because Harrison had used up all the luck he had accumulated during this period of time, but this time, he did not get anything good from touching Ding Pan Long. They were all ordinary skills, except for one of them.

[Taunting Habit]: After activating the skill, your words are more likely to be misunderstood by the other party. -50% Favorability Increase Efficiency, + 100% Favorability Decrease Efficiency. When you communicate with the enemy in battle, the enemy has a greater chance of treating you as the target of their attacks (The chance depends on Charm, Luck, and Favorability. The lower the chance, the easier it is to become the target of their hatred). No cost. It can be activated for at least three minutes after activation. No cooldown.

"No wonder this guy is so annoying. Could it be that he has never turned off this skill before?"

Every time he saw the introduction of this ability and thought of Dylan's daily behavior, Han Xiao could not help but fall into deep thought.

Was it Dylan's habit of having a foul mouth that formed this ability, or was it this ability that developed Dylan's habit of having a foul mouth … This was a question of whether the chicken or the egg came first.

Putting these factors aside, Han Xiao was actually quite satisfied with the effect of the skill alone.

Taunting skills were not common. Instead, they were rather rare in the galaxy. The biggest difficulty for players when fighting bosses was that intelligent creatures did not have a rigid aggro mechanism. If they wanted to pull monsters and taunt them, they could only use tactical cooperation. There was basically no rough and simple forced taunting.

The most common ability to attract aggro was the mental guidance of Mages or Psychics, hinting at who the enemy was going to attack, but it was often resisted by mental toughness.

"The vast universe is really full of strange things. Even the chat tactic has a proper skill bonus … I have to use it more in the future."

Han Xiao's eyes twitched.

My style is becoming more and more like a qualified main tank. I have a feeling that if this continues, my title as the chief Mechanic of Galaxy will become the number one meat shield in the universe sooner or later.
